title: Spotify Plus Extension Manifest
description: Configuration file for submitting an extension to the Spotify Plus marketplace

id.description: A unique identifier for your extension

version.description: The current version of your extension

authors.description: A list of authors who worked on this extension.

tags.description: Tags used to categorize your extension

api.description: The Spotify Plus API version this extension uses. The current latest is 2

main.description: Path to the main JavaScript file

preview.description: Path to the image used as a preview in the marketplace

banner.description: Path to the image used as a banner in the marketplace

assets.description: An array of asset paths or glob patterns used by your extension

native.description: Information about the native code your extension uses

Author.description: An author who worked on the extension

url.description: A URL to the author's GitHub or other profile

NativeMetadata.description: Metadata for an extension's native Android plugin

apk.description: Path to the APK file, starting from the directory of your main JavaScript file

pluginClass.description: Full name of the native plugin entry point class
